tasks.short: Discuss event needs with clients and venues

steps.what: Communicate with clients and venue owners to clarify music preferences, scheduling and anticipated attendance

tasks.design: Retain the conversation that discovers what the client and venue actually need. A form can support the discussion but is not credited with replacing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preferences and expectations are often incomplete or contradictory.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement for the relationship and clarification work is established.
tasks.still_hard: Understand what a client means by a desired atmosphere.
tasks.human_edge: Ask useful follow up questions and reconcile expectations.
tasks.altitude: Improve the clarity of the event brief.

evidence.claim: Event requirements discovery remains a client conversation; no measured saving is established.

assumptions: The disc jockey obtains preferences, timing and attendance estimates during s1; no finished structured brief is assumed as an input.
The client and venue provide answers during the discussion, with clarification retained.
No new tool is deployed and upkeep is zero. Contract specific field capture is counted separately without repeating this discovery baseline.
unknowns: Typical number of client and venue discussions
research_questions: Which ambiguities most often cause changes near the event?

incremental.description: No changed system or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: the discovery conversation remains fully counted; zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify payments due and approve payment requests before sending them to customers
Match settled payments to approved references and record exact receipts
Collect cash payments and resolve unmatched, disputed or overdue amounts personally

tasks.design: Use native payment requests and exact receipt matching in {ERP} with {BANK}. The disc jockey verifies the amount and recipient before requesting payment, while cash, disputes and unmatched receipts remain personal work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Payment collection may require repeated manual checks and receipt entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native payment references can link a settled receipt to a specific approved request.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve disputes and collect payment when the customer cannot use the normal route.
tasks.human_edge: Handle a sensitive payment conversation without losing the relationship.
tasks.altitude: Manage collection exceptions instead of checking every settled receipt.

reach.learn: Distinguish settlement evidence from a payment promise

evidence.claim: Exact native payment matching can remove repeat receipt entry; the DJ collection scenario is unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the disc jockey captures booking identifier, exact amount, currency, recipient contact, due date and payment reference from the agreement and billing record. Capture, checking and missing detail resolution are counted in 35 hours.

After the request, the customer initiates payment and the bank produces transaction identifier, settled amount, currency, reference and settlement state. The bank record is not assumed available before the customer pays.
Only exact settled matches are posted internally and remain auditable and reversible. Pending, duplicate or unmatched receipts go to s3; the service never initiates a debit or refund.
Native functions come first. New customer effort to use the payment route is charged below; cash remains a manual fallback.
unknowns: Payment method mix and existing receipt matching
research_questions: Does exact matching save time after request verification and customer support?

already_counted.description: Payment request capture, approval and collection exceptions

incremental.description: Receipt reconciliation and matching rule upkeep
Additional customer effort using the payment request route

approvals.approved_version: Exact amount, currency, booking, recipient and payment reference; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=70 gives 30 gross and 22 net after 8 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-6 allows cash and disputes to dominate or matching to exist already; customer and support effort is separately visible.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture agreed booking terms and resolve missing contract details
Populate written contracts using checked booking fields and unchanged standard clauses
Check contracts against agreed terms and approve the version sent for acceptance

tasks.design: Configure a booking contract template in {DOCS} and send only after checking via {EMAIL}. It places agreed fields into approved wording and never invents cancellation or liability terms.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring booking terms were recopied into similar contracts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can assemble fixed clauses and supplied fields.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve nonstandard terms and ensure the contract reflects the agreement.
tasks.human_edge: Spot a mismatch between apparent agreement and the client's expectations.

reach.learn: Recognise when a nonstandard clause needs qualified review

evidence.claim: Fixed booking contract templates can place supplied terms without a model; the proposed savings are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the disc jockey produces client identity, venue, event date, performance times, fee, payment dates, equipment responsibilities and selected standard template version. Capture, clarification and corrections are counted in 30 hours.
Initial event discovery belongs only to task 22609; s1 here formalises and verifies already discussed contract terms rather than claiming the same conversation again.
Native templates are used before custom software. Missing terms or nonstandard clauses trigger manual composition and appropriate review within s3.
The template never interprets an email as acceptance or signs a contract.
unknowns: Share of bookings using one standard agreement
research_questions: Does templating reduce total contract preparation time after term capture and checking?

already_counted.description: Term capture, exception handling and issue approval

incremental.description: Template upkeep and sampled contract checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact contract version, booking terms, clauses and recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100 and R=60 yield 40 gross and 33 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-12 allows nonstandard terms, native templates already in use and field capture overhead.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and play music for the live crowd

steps.what: Select and play music while responding to crowd preferences, mood and live transitions

tasks.design: Retain live music selection and performance with the disc jockey. Track identification does not replace reading the crowd or choosing the next transition.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value comes from creative choices responsive to the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Music recognition exists but does not establish replacement of live selection.
tasks.still_hard: Sense when to continue a mood or change direction.
tasks.human_edge: Taste, timing and responsiveness to the audience.
tasks.altitude: Develop performance judgement and a flexible repertoire.

reach.task: Discuss musical flow for an event
reach.learn: Connect a programme to observed audience response

evidence.claim: BumaStemra music identification fingerprints audio into setlists; this is a recording capability rather than live artistic selection.
Retaining live selection and performance establishes no labour saving for this task.

assumptions: The disc jockey perceives crowd response during s1; no structured crowd mood flag is assumed.
Setlist reporting is outside this task and receives no savings here.
No additional software is deployed and upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Venue type and scope for live selection
research_questions: Which performance choices most improve the audience experience?

already_counted.description: Crowd observation, music selection and live performance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: the live performance remains full time, with zero gross and net savings.

role.altitude: Reduce repetitive booking paperwork while protecting client understanding and live artistic judgement.
reach: Help event producers prepare clearer standard agreements and reconcile receipts
role.ambitious_version: A disc jockey with reliable booking administration and preserved time for clients and the room.
